baseline_formula.overlap: Do not sum people across games, editions or scenarios
baseline_formula.uncalibrated_priors: Existing K/G/p and acquisition coefficients remain expert hypotheses, not measured conversions

rating_change_gate.approval_scope: Exact proposal ID and version; any active numeric/rank/membership/method change

signal_types.valid_use: Audience scale evidence with purchaser-to-GM uncertainty
signal_types.do_not: Invent hidden itch/DriveThruRPG sales or turn reviews/badges into exact active GMs

signal_types.measures: Historical backers or orders of exact campaign
signal_types.do_not: Add overlapping campaigns or treat backers as current GMs

signal_types.measures: Independent author/project own-map preparation or played campaign
signal_types.valid_use: Validate actual use case and unresolved map need
signal_types.do_not: Treat modules/translations/chapters as independent people or derive p without denominator
Use search result counts or incomparable normalized series as volume

signal_types.measures: Dated content/metadata/transcript, author/channel and actual map task
signal_types.do_not: Equate views with GMs or reviews with map creation

signal_types.measures: Deduplicated public GM identifiers, system/edition, location/language, campaign/one-shot, frequency, announced/ran/cancelled
signal_types.valid_use: Observable organised-play system use and formats in bounded sample
signal_types.do_not: Multiply slots into unique GMs, conflate names or extrapolate club census to whole market

signal_types.measures: Deduplicated event-system slots/GMs/formats/date and scheduled/ran status
signal_types.do_not: Infer map/hexcrawl prevalence from convention one-shots

signal_types.valid_use: Visibility, candidate discovery, dated attention hypothesis
signal_types.do_not: Apply audience bonus or claim causal acquisition without validated data

signal_types.measures: Public dated permalinks, author/project, subreddit, post type, edition/format; crosspost keys
signal_types.valid_use: Find actual play/maps/LFG/unmet needs and new candidates
signal_types.do_not: Equate votes/subscribers/comments/promotions to active GMs or completed campaigns

signal_types.measures: Platform-specific dated accounts/campaigns/usage under published definitions
signal_types.valid_use: Qualified proxy with platform and role bias
signal_types.do_not: Use all players/platform users as suitable regional-map GMs

signal_types.definition: Public player/GM survey questions about systems actually played or run, qualified by exact wording, recall period, role and sample. Preference/ownership/intention questions remain separate constructs.
signal_types.measures: Self-reported system choices/playing or GMing within a defined sampled group and period.
signal_types.valid_use: Bounded system-use evidence, triangulation of popularity assumptions and discovery of overlooked candidates; evaluate suitability for target before any numerical use.
signal_types.do_not: Equate choice marks to people, players to GMs, popular systems to regionalmap use or community opt-in shares to a representative globalmarket.
signal_types.unit: Per-question valid respondents and response marks; single/multiple selection explicitly distinguished.
signal_types.period: Fieldwork, publication, and behavior recall window recorded separately; historical waves not currentactivity.
signal_types.geography_language: Actual recruitment/language/location and weighting recorded; unknown remains unknown.
signal_types.population_or_sampling_frame: Organizer, eligibility, recruitment channels, sampling design, duplicate handling and weighting; convenience/self-selection explicit.
signal_types.availability_and_access: Canonical primary questionnaire/results/method/rawdata access by source; fulltext/metadata/snippet/unavailable.
signal_types.deduplication: Organizer/study/wave key; mirrors/translations/charts not independent samples; multi-system respondents overlap; no de-anonymization.
signal_types.target_variable: System-use prevalence within observed frame; role-specific or map/hexcrawl targets only when exact relevant question/data supports them.
signal_types.calibration_or_qualitative_only: qualitative_only until validated sampling/construct calibration; any active numeric effect requires approved exact-version proposal.
signal_types.uncertainty: Itemn, respondent uniqueness, rawdata availability, coding rules, changes across waves and target-market transportability.
signal_types.validation_or_falsification: Question text/recall/role matches target; denominators explicit; multi-answer totals/dedup checked; primarydata vs narrative discrepancies preserved; incompatible waves not trended.

extensions.definition: Publisher/rule text establishes that a map-creation procedure or format exists; distinct from actual GM use.
extensions.period: Source-specific publication dates, unknown when unverified
extensions.geography_language: English sources; global audience inference prohibited
extensions.population_or_sampling_frame: Purposeful primary-source discovery for bounded creation refinement
extensions.availability_and_access: Full text versus search snippet recorded per observation
extensions.deduplication: Canonical URL, author/project key and legacy crossrefs; rechecks not new people
extensions.biases: Publication and discovery bias; rule existence is not usage prevalence
extensions.uncertainty: No sampled denominator, no active GM count
extensions.validation_or_falsification: Exact edition text or primary authored artifact can contradict classification; no claims of full rules corpus
